author: Vox
description:
How do we keep the feeling of powerlessness from turning into acquiescence?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In this episode of The Gray Area, guest host Jonquilyn Hill sits down with Nobel Peace Prize-winning journalist and Rappler co-founder Maria Ressa. They discuss her new book, The Fight Back: A Citizen’s Guide to Standing Up to Dictators, which explores the striking parallels between political dictators like Rodrigo Duterte and modern tech oligarchs like Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

Ressa breaks down how social media algorithms weaponize human attention and biology, the rise of narrative warfare, the decline of independent journalism, and how everyday citizens can reclaim their agency and fight back against authoritarian control.

Host: Jonquilyn Hill, host of Explain It To Me
Guests: Maria Ressa, author The Fight Back: A Citizen’s Guide to Standing Up to Dictators

author: Vox
description:
Something strange is happening way, way past Pluto. Astronomers kept finding small, icy objects out there, some of which were oddly clumped together, as if something heavy had herded them into place. That “something” became known as Planet Nine, but no one has ever found it. 

Astrophysicist Dr. Becky Smethurst says her favorite far-out theory is that it isn’t a planet at all. It could be a tiny pet black hole for our solar system. 🪐
